name: Isaac Lab Task Contract Check
description: Validate the UR10e gear assembly task id, gripper choice, observation contract, and nominal action scale.
validators: task id must be Isaac-Deploy-GearAssembly-UR10e-2F140-v0 or Isaac-Deploy-GearAssembly-UR10e-2F85-v0
policy observations must include joint_pos, joint_vel, gear_shaft_pos, gear_shaft_quat
2F-140 nominal action scale must be 0.0325 and 2F-85 nominal action scale must be 0.025
